# Stress Headings

## 4. Requirements

### FR-CLI-816 — Forbidden `code` heading content

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | functional |
| Target | v2.3.0 |
| Status | planned |
| Priority | medium |
| Risk | low |
| Stability | stable |

#### Requirement

The stress fixture must report forbidden inline Markdown in headings.

#### Rationale

Heading parsing must remain deterministic for tool-driven edits.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Forbidden heading diagnostics are emitted.
